title: Page 4
content_zh:
“老公，你当初为什么会娶我？”
“问这个干什么？”肖崇源正在电脑前工作，头也不抬。
“就是好奇。”
“你又在胡思乱想什么，乖，快去睡觉吧。”
“老公……”温宁不依不饶地凑到电脑前，把脸挡过去，眨眨眼问：“你爱我吗？”
“阿宁……”肖崇源微微蹙眉，耐心道：“我还有很多工作要做。”
“怎么不回答？”温宁难得变得执拗。
“阿宁，别闹了。”肖崇源放重了语气。
“这个问题很难回答吗？我现在真的很怀疑，你到底对这段婚姻抱持着什么样的态度？”温宁忽然就生气了，猛地直起身子，气呼呼地盯着他。
肖崇源揉了揉眉心，终于抬起眼打量了她一下，然后忽然说：“你换发型了？”
温宁被他问得一愣，下意识回答道：“嗯……是啊，好看吗？”
她早就想让肖崇源注意到了，所以换过发型后一直在他身边打转，但他却完全当她是空气，现在他忽然提到这件事，倒令盛怒中的温宁有了些期待。
“不太好，换回去吧。”
温宁像是被兜头浇了盆冷水，方才勉强压下去的怒火更强烈地涌了回来，她紧咬着红唇，看了肖崇源一会后，闷不吭声地走回卧室，用力地关上了门。
当晚肖崇源工作完毕，去找温宁缠绵的时候，毫无意外地被她狠狠拒绝了，肖崇源哄了一会都没效果，也不禁动了怒，披上睡衣去客房睡了。
之后他们冷战了一段时间，但冷战过后等待他们的却不是和好如初，这场争执像是平静婚姻上的一个裂缝，彼此的不满逐渐自裂缝涌出来，温宁不满他对自己的忽视，而肖崇源不满她的变化。
肖崇源看出了温宁的蜕变，也不得不承认现在的她变得美了很多，不过这并不是他想要的。
肖崇源向来不喜欢美女，他当初会娶温宁正是因为她姿色平平，性格也安静，但现在他才发觉妻子和自己想像的不太一样，她不仅不丑，性格也越来越开朗，偶尔也会和朋友出去游玩，不再是新婚时那个只会在家守候着他的女人。
肖崇源觉得是温宁变了，她总是对他大有不满，他身为男人，让着她也无所谓，更何况他还要打拚自己的事业，没那么多心力。
不过肖崇源的忍耐，终于在温宁提出要去当模特儿的时候到达了极限。

“不行！”
“为什么？”
“你要出去工作，我并不反对，但不可以做模特儿，那不是你该做的。”
“什么才是我该做的？”
“处理好家事才是你该做的事。”肖崇源凝视着她，眼神充满了压迫感，“这个家并不需要你出去赚钱，如果你觉得无聊，那我可以在医院帮你安排个闲职，薪水你来定。”
“你说的生活并不是我想要的，我才二十三岁，不可能当一个全职家庭主妇，我也有自己的喜好、自己的梦想。”温宁觉得肖崇源这样说简直是在羞辱自己。
“你的梦想就是当模特儿？”
“是。”
“所以你才努力地把自己打扮得这么美？”
“我美吗？”温宁的注意力又成功地被他引开了。
“嗯。”
“那……啊，不要唬弄我，反正我要出去工作。”
“不行，我绝不允许我的妻子去当模特儿。”
除非他们离婚，否则他不会让自己的妻子穿那种曝露的衣服给别人看！
温宁自嘲地一笑，“这个时候你就把我当成妻子了？那你夜不归宿，对家里的事不闻不问的时候，又把我当成了什么？保姆、厨师、暖床的工具？”
“不要把话说得那么难听。”
“是你把事情做得很难看！”
“阿宁！”
“肖崇源，你到底为什么要娶我？娶了我以后又为什么把我冷冻在家里？”
“婚前我不知道你是这么爱抱怨的女人。”

“那你觉得我是个怎样的女人？”
“安静、话少、长得不漂亮。”
“所以你才会娶我？”温宁觉得很不可思议。
“你不也是因为我家底殷实才嫁给我的吗？”
肖崇源变相地承认了这个问题，三个月的相处，怎么会有爱情？
温宁觉得自己果然是太天真了，“原来我们只是……单纯的商业联姻。”
肖崇源因为她受伤的表情而心生不忍，但又觉得让她抱有太多希望反而更残忍，他想了想，狠心地说：“相亲前，你妈没有和你说清楚？”
即便是那时没说清楚，温宁现在也看清了。
自此他们的婚姻正式告急，肖崇源本以为时间久了，温宁会改变主意，可没想到她当模特儿的决心十分坚定，不仅如此，她的那些“温柔安静”也全都不见了。
于是无休无止的争吵、冷战开始纠缠着他们，两个人几乎见面就会吵，而吵架的内容也都如出一辙，无非是她抱怨他对婚姻不负责、控制欲强，而他则指责她性格大变，简直就是骗婚。
“早知道你是这种女人，我就不该娶你！”
“彼此彼此，我也是被你人模狗样的外表骗到了。”
“骗婚，你这是骗婚！”
“哈哈，你这笑话可真好笑！”
肖崇源不想再和她浪费口水，冷哼了一声转身就走。
在他离开公寓之前，温宁鼓足了勇气说：“肖崇源，我们离婚吧。”
肖崇源身影一顿，头也没回地走进电梯。
半个月后的某一天，也就是他们结婚的第三百七十七天，肖崇源和温宁正式协议离婚。
第2章(1)
离婚两年，温宁和肖崇源生活的轨迹似乎已经成了两条平行线。

肖崇源的B&W整形医院已经成为业界翘楚，温宁为了追求梦想，离家出走来到台北工作，他们都以为彼此不会再有见面的机会，但谁能想到造化弄人，他们居然以这种方式再次碰面。
肖崇源站在办公室的落地窗前，居高临下地审视着那抹倩影气呼呼地离开医院，走到一半鞋跟一扭，害得她险些跌倒，温宁懊恼地弯腰揉了揉脚，气得把高跟鞋脱下来提在手里。
肖崇源环着手臂，无声地嘲笑她。
助理余放顺着他的目光往楼下看，越看越好奇，差点就贴到肖崇源脸边看了。
肖崇源一偏头就看见余放的大脸，伸手一推，“看什么？”
余放瘪了瘪嘴，“你前妻满漂亮的啊。”
肖崇源冷哼了一声：“漂亮有个屁用。”
肖院长也会这么粗鲁？余放疑惑地瞄了他一眼，试探道：“好歹夫妻一场，真不帮忙？更何况我们还有钱赚。”
肖崇源斜了他一眼，“离婚后她二姊为难肖氏企业的时候，她怎么不顾念夫妻一场？现在有麻烦才来求我，当我这里是慈善机构吗？”
肖院长怎么这么小气呢？这还是那个优雅、高贵、冷酷的业界菁英肖崇源吗？
在余放诧异的目光中，肖崇源圈着手臂，满脸冷笑地说：“不过真没想到温宁居然会放下身段来找我，模特儿助理？她还真敢做。”
现在想想温宁那狼狈的样子，肖崇源就觉得好笑，他无声地哼笑了几下，然后用手肘撞了撞余放，“你说她家怎么会同意……”
话说到一半，肖崇源忽然闭嘴，他斜了满脸八卦的余放一眼，清了清嗓子，“不工作了？去把病人的资料整理一下。”
余放悻悻地摸了摸鼻子，依依不舍地往落地窗外看了一眼，乖乖地去工作了。
耳根清静之后，肖崇源复而朝窗外看了看，发觉那抹倩影已经消失了，应该是坐上家里的专车了吧？呵呵，这肯定是小公主出来体验穷人生活的戏码，一时心血来潮当起助理来，等她玩腻了，自然就乖乖回家继续做她的富家小姐了，他倒要看看温宁能坚持多久。
content_en:
"Husband, why did you marry me in the first place?"
"Why are you asking this?" Xiao Chongyuan was working in front of the computer without raising his head.
"Just curious."
"What are you thinking about again? Be good, go to bed."
"Husband..." Wen Ning reluctantly approached the computer, shielded his face, blinked and asked, "Do you love me?"
"Aning..." Xiao Chongyuan frowned slightly and said patiently: "I still have a lot of work to do."
"Why don't you answer?" Wen Ning rarely became stubborn.
"Aning, stop making trouble." Xiao Chongyuan said in a serious tone.
"Is this question difficult to answer? Now I really doubt what attitude you have towards this marriage?" Wen Ning suddenly became angry, straightened up suddenly, and stared at him angrily.
Xiao Chongyuan rubbed his eyebrows, finally raised his eyes and looked at her, and then suddenly said: "Have you changed your hairstyle?"
Wen Ning was stunned by his question and subconsciously replied: "Hmm...yeah, does it look good?"
She had long wanted Xiao Chongyuan to notice her, so she kept hanging around him after changing her hairstyle, but he completely treated her as nothing. Now that he suddenly mentioned this matter, Wen Ning, who was in a rage, had some expectations.
"It's not good. Let's change it back."
Wen Ning felt as if cold water had been poured on her head, and the anger that she had just suppressed surged back even more intensely. She bit her red lips tightly, looked at Xiao Chongyuan for a while, then walked back to the bedroom without saying a word, and closed the door forcefully.
That night, when Xiao Chongyuan finished work and went to have sex with Wen Ning, he was rejected by her without any surprise. Xiao Chongyuan coaxed her for a while but to no avail, so he couldn't help but get angry, put on his pajamas and went to the guest room to sleep.
After that, they had a cold war for a while, but what awaited them after the cold war was not reconciliation. This dispute was like a crack in a peaceful marriage, and mutual dissatisfaction gradually emerged from the crack. Wen Ning was dissatisfied with his neglect of her, while Xiao Chongyuan was dissatisfied with her changes.
Xiao Chongyuan saw Wen Ning's transformation and had to admit that she was much more beautiful now, but this was not what he wanted.
Xiao Chongyuan has never liked beautiful women. He originally married Wen Ning because of her plain appearance and quiet personality. But now he realizes that his wife is different from what he imagined. Not only is she not ugly, but her personality is becoming more and more cheerful. She occasionally goes out with friends to play. She is no longer the woman who only stayed at home to wait for him when he was newly married.
Xiao Chongyuan felt that Wen Ning had changed. She was always very dissatisfied with him. As a man, it didn't matter if he let her go. What's more, he had to work hard on his own career and didn't have so much energy.
However, Xiao Chongyuan's patience finally reached its limit when Wen Ning proposed to become a model.
"No!"
"Why?"
"I don't object to you going out to work, but you can't be a model. That's not what you should do."
"What should I do?"
"Taking care of the housework is what you should do." Xiao Chongyuan stared at her, his eyes full of oppression, "This family does not need you to go out to make money. If you feel bored, then I can help you arrange a part-time job in the hospital, and you can decide the salary."
"The life you mentioned is not what I want. I am only twenty-three years old and cannot be a full-time housewife. I also have my own preferences and dreams." Wen Ning felt that Xiao Chongyuan was simply humiliating himself by saying this.
"Your dream is to be a model?"
"Yes."
"Is that why you work so hard to dress yourself up so beautifully?"
"Am I beautiful?" Wen Ning's attention was successfully diverted by him again.
"Yeah."
"Then...ah, don't fool me, I have to go out to work anyway."
"No, I will never allow my wife to become a model."
Unless they divorce, he will not let his wife wear such revealing clothes for others to see!
Wen Ning smiled self-deprecatingly, "You can treat me as your wife at this time.Already? Then what do you think of me when you stay up all night and don't care about things at home? A nanny, a cook, a bed warmer? "
"Don't put it in such a bad way. "
"You made things look ugly! "
"Aning! "
"Xiao Chongyuan, why on earth did you want to marry me? Why did you freeze me at home after you married me? "
“I didn’t know you were such a complaining woman before marriage. "
"Then what kind of woman do you think I am? "
“Quiet, talks little, and not pretty. "
"Is that why you married me? "Wen Ning found it incredible.
"Didn't you marry me because my family is well off? "
Xiao Chongyuan admitted this problem in disguise. How could there be love after three months of getting along?
Wen Ning felt that he was indeed too naive, "It turns out that we were just... a simple business marriage. "
Xiao Chongyuan couldn't bear it because of her hurt expression, but he also felt that it would be cruel to let her have too much hope. He thought about it and said cruelly: "Didn't your mother make it clear to you before the blind date? "
Even if he didn't make it clear at the time, Wen Ning could see it clearly now.
Since then, their marriage has officially come to an end. Xiao Chongyuan thought that Wen Ning would change her mind over time, but he did not expect that her determination to become a model was very firm. Not only that, but all her "gentleness and quietness" were also gone.
As a result, endless quarrels and cold wars began to plague them. The two would quarrel almost every time they met, and the content of the quarrels was exactly the same. She complained that he was irresponsible and controlling in the marriage, while he accused her of a drastic change in personality, which was simply a marriage fraud.
"If I had known you were this kind of woman, I shouldn't have married you! "
"Both and each other, I was also deceived by your dog-like appearance. "
“Marriage fraud, you are committing marriage fraud! "
"Haha, your joke is so funny! "
Xiao Chongyuan didn't want to waste any more words with her, so he snorted and turned around to leave.
Before he left the apartment, Wen Ning summoned up the courage to say: "Xiao Chongyuan, let's get a divorce. "
Xiao Chongyuan paused and walked into the elevator without looking back.
One day half a month later, on the 377th day of their marriage, Xiao Chongyuan and Wen Ning formally agreed to divorce.
Chapter 2(1)
Two years after their divorce, Wen Ning and Xiao Chongyuan's life trajectories seemed to have become two parallel lines.
Xiao Chongyuan's B&W Plastic Surgery Hospital has become a leader in the industry. In order to pursue his dream, Wen Ning ran away from home and came to Taipei to work. They both thought they would never have the chance to meet each other again, but who could have imagined that they would meet again in this way.
Xiao Chongyuan stood in front of the floor-to-ceiling window of the office, looking down at the beautiful figure. He left the hospital angrily. Halfway through, the heel of his shoe twisted, causing her to almost fall. Wen Ning bent over and rubbed her feet in annoyance. He was so angry that he took off his high heels and held them in his hands.
Xiao Chongyuan crossed his arms and laughed at her silently.
Assistant Yu Fang followed his gaze and looked downstairs. The more he looked, the more curious he became, and he almost looked right in front of Xiao Chongyuan's face.
Xiao Chongyuan turned his head and saw Yu Fang's big face, stretched out his hand and pushed, "What are you looking at? "
Yu Fang pursed his lips, "Your ex-wife is very beautiful. "
Xiao Chongyuan snorted coldly: "Being pretty is useless. "
Would Dean Xiao be so rude? Yu Fang glanced at him doubtfully and said tentatively: "After all, we are just a husband and wife, and you really don't want to help? What's more, we still make money. "
Xiao Chongyuan glanced at him sideways, "When her second sister made things difficult for Xiao's company after the divorce, why didn't she care about the couple? If you come to me now when you are in trouble, do you think this is a charity? "
Why is Dean Xiao so stingy? Is this still the elegant, noble and cold industry elite Xiao Chongyuan?
Under Yu Fang's surprised gaze, Xiao Chongyuan circled his arms and said with a sneer: "But I didn't expect Wen Ning to actually put down his body and come to see me, model assistant?She really dared to do it. "
Now thinking about Wen Ning's embarrassed look, Xiao Chongyuan found it funny. He chuckled silently a few times, then bumped Yu Fang with his elbow, "Why do you think her family would agree..."
Halfway through his words, Xiao Chongyuan suddenly shut up. He glanced sideways at Yu Fang, who had a face full of gossip, and cleared his throat, "You're not working anymore? Go and sort out the patient's information. "
Yu Fang touched his nose angrily, glanced reluctantly out of the French window, and went to work obediently.
After his ears were quiet, Xiao Chongyuan looked out the window again and found that the beautiful figure had disappeared. He must have gotten into his family's car, right? Haha, this must be the story of a little princess who comes out to experience the life of a poor man and becomes an assistant on a whim. When she gets tired of playing, she will naturally go home and continue being her rich lady. He wants to see how long Wen Ning can last.
